page.overview:
Who is The Hunk?

The Hunk is a muscular blond man who participated in the preselection for the new Guardians of the Globe as he was interested in applying. He went up against Atom Eve and loses against her in a fight. When Robot announces the new Guardians of the Globe, the Hunk is not selected as one of the members.

The Hunk was later killed by one of the Evil Invincibles in the Invincible War.

The Hunk's build is that of a very muscular body builder, he has blond straight hair, no shirt, and wears only shorts.

Very little was seen of the Hunk's personality, save for the fact that he appeared to be somewhat arrogant and egotistical because of his muscles.
